title: Update Status v1
description: Structured update availability and restart status for Rig Relay sessions. Embedded in current_state to give agents and users visibility into pending updates without workflow disruption.

current_version.description: Currently installed Rig Relay version (PEP 440 format).

install_source.description: How Rig Relay was installed, to determine the recommended update command.

recommended_update_command.description: Shell command the user should run to update.

restart_required.description: True if the update requires a restart.

restart_safe.description: True if no active sessions block restart.

blocked_by_active_sessions.description: Number of active sessions blocking restart.

update_state.description: Current state in the update lifecycle.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last update check.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the update check.
